plan: Treat every pick as a lottery ticket with research behind it: size so a total loss doesn't matter.
Put at most 1% of your portfolio into one altcoin, and at most 0.5% into one meme coin.
Keep the whole altcoin basket under 10% of your portfolio, across at most 10 coins.
Only buy after you have ticked the checklist yourself: live product, real use, active channels, no big unlocks ahead.
Buy in two halves a few days apart; skip the second half if the story weakened.
At 2x, sell half to take your stake back; let the rest run free.
At 5x and 10x, sell another quarter of what's left each time.
Sell everything if the thesis breaks: product shut down, team gone, liquidity pulled, exploit, or delisting.
No stop-loss on price alone for utility coins (they swing 50% routinely); size small instead. For meme coins, exit if volume dries up for a week.
Log each buy in the Journal with why you bought it, and review the basket monthly.
